title: A code-lane worker runs its selection and the changed-path tests, and the whole suite at most once, so parallel workers and landings do not push each other over the ceiling
goal: The brief of a code-lane item tells its worker to run its own check selections and tests.py --changed origin/main while it works and the whole suite at most once before its report (SP-waxgh3kg: each of four code workers ran the whole suite two or three times, every run refused over seconds while landings ran theirs on the same host); a test of brief ID on a code item asserts the line.
